subcommands.name: get-clip
subcommands.description: Downloads an MP4 file (clip) containing the archived, on-demand media from the specified video stream over the specified time range.

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The name of the stream for which to retrieve the media clip.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream for which to retrieve the media clip.

options.name: --clip-fragment-selector
options.description: The time range of the requested clip and the source of the timestamps

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: get-dash-streaming-session-url
subcommands.description: Retrieves an MPEG Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) URL for the stream.

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The name of the stream for which to retrieve the MPEG-DASH manifest URL.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream for which to retrieve the MPEG-DASH manifest URL.

options.name: --playback-mode
options.description: Whether to retrieve live, live replay, or archived, on-demand data.

options.name: --display-fragment-timestamp
options.description: Per the MPEG-DASH specification, the wall-clock time of fragments in the manifest file can be derived using attributes in the manifest itself.

options.name: --display-fragment-number
options.description: Fragments are identified in the manifest file based on their sequence number in the session.

options.name: --dash-fragment-selector
options.description: The time range of the requested fragment and the source of the timestamps.

options.name: --expires
options.description: The time in seconds until the requested session expires.

options.name: --max-manifest-fragment-results
options.description: The maximum number of fragments that are returned in the MPEG-DASH manifest.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-hls-streaming-session-url
subcommands.description: Retrieves an HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) URL for the stream.

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The name of the stream for which to retrieve the HLS master playlist URL.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream for which to retrieve the HLS master playlist URL.

options.name: --playback-mode
options.description: Whether to retrieve live, live replay, or archived, on-demand data.

options.name: --hls-fragment-selector
options.description: The time range of the requested fragment and the source of the timestamps.

options.name: --container-format
options.description: Specifies which format should be used for packaging the media.

options.name: --discontinuity-mode
options.description: Specifies when flags marking discontinuities between fragments are added to the media playlists.

options.name: --display-fragment-timestamp
options.description: Specifies when the fragment start timestamps should be included in the HLS media playlist.

options.name: --expires
options.description: The time in seconds until the requested session expires.

options.name: --max-media-playlist-fragment-results
options.description: The maximum number of fragments that are returned in the HLS media playlists.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-images
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of images corresponding to each timestamp for a given time range, sampling interval, and image format configuration

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The name of the stream from which to retrieve the images.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream from which to retrieve the images.

options.name: --image-selector-type
options.description: The origin of the Server or Producer timestamps to use to generate the images

options.name: --start-timestamp
options.description: The starting point from which the images should be generated.

options.name: --end-timestamp
options.description: The end timestamp for the range of images to be generated.

options.name: --sampling-interval
options.description: The time interval in milliseconds (ms) at which the images need to be generated from the stream.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format that will be used to encode the image

options.name: --format-config
options.description: The list of a key-value pair structure that contains extra parameters that can be applied when the image is generated.

options.name: --width-pixels
options.description: The width of the output image that is used in conjunction with the HeightPixels parameter.

options.name: --height-pixels
options.description: The height of the output image that is used in conjunction with the WidthPixels parameter.

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of images to be returned by the API.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: A token that specifies where to start paginating the next set of Images.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --starting-token
options.description: A token to specify where to start paginating.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: The size of each page to get in the AWS service call.

options.name: --max-items
options.description: The total number of items to return in the command's output.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-media-for-fragment-list
subcommands.description: Gets media for a list of fragments (specified by fragment number) from the archived data in an Amazon Kinesis video stream.

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The name of the stream from which to retrieve fragment media.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream from which to retrieve fragment media.

options.name: --fragments
options.description: A list of the numbers of fragments for which to retrieve media.

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: list-fragments
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Fragment objects from the specified stream and timestamp range within the archived data.

options.name: --stream-arn

options.name: --next-token

options.name: --fragment-selector

options.name: --max-items
